The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

videos.caption: One of the things I loved most about making #Animals was getting to interrogate the complexities of marriage. Mark and Abby’s marriage in particular. The masks they wear, the bargains they make, the secrets they keep from each other and from themselves! The film asks: what happens when a crisis forces all of it into the light?  Exploring all of that with Ben was a gift. Since he’s not on social, I can safely say this here and pray that no one shows it to him 🤣 I’ve admired Ben as a filmmaker for a very long time, but getting to be directed by him AND act opposite him was a transformative experience. It changed me as an artist. As an actor, his performance is fearless and raw. As a director, he created an environment that invited EVERYONE to contribute at their highest level -  be vulnerable, take big swings, ask the scary questions, and really dig in. This entire cast and crew has my heart.  Can’t wait to hear your thoughts…. ❤️ #AnimalsNetflix
